northStar: A fully reproducible, multi-venue prediction-markets research and execution stack with hedge-fund-grade data lineage, calibration discipline, portfolio construction, and production controls.

domainSummaries.title: Point-in-Time Data And Replay
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Serious systematic research depends on point-in-time data integrity, replayability, and leakage control.
domainSummaries.objective: Every research result and paper/live decision must be regenerable from archived venue data, anchor data, and deterministic replay tooling.

domainSummaries.title: Semantic Normalization And Contract Graphs
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Prediction markets are structurally heterogeneous, so alpha extraction requires semantic normalization before modeling.
domainSummaries.objective: Reduce venue-specific contracts into a canonical graph of thresholds, buckets, complements, partitions, and temporal nesting relationships.

domainSummaries.title: Modeling, Calibration, And Benchmarking
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Proper scoring rules, benchmark baselines, and calibration checks are standard for probabilistic forecasting and should anchor all fair-value work.
domainSummaries.objective: Every model must be benchmarked against sensible baselines, segmented by regime, and evaluated with proper scoring plus stability diagnostics.

domainSummaries.title: Simulation, Paper Trading, And Execution Realism
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Execution assumptions dominate live viability, so simulations must reflect fill uncertainty, slippage, and venue constraints.
domainSummaries.objective: Bridge research signals into realistic paper and later live execution loops with explicit assumptions and measurable degradation versus idealized alpha.

domainSummaries.title: Portfolio Construction And Risk
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Portfolio construction matters as much as signal quality because overlapping contracts can create hidden concentration and false diversification.
domainSummaries.objective: Translate trade-level alpha into capital allocation that respects overlap, regime, venue, liquidity, and tail-risk constraints.

domainSummaries.title: Production Controls, Governance, And Observability
domainSummaries.researchBasis: Institutional robustness requires controlled promotion from research to paper to production, with guardrails and auditability.
domainSummaries.objective: Make the platform operable and reviewable by a research lead, risk lead, and engineer without relying on tribal knowledge.

capabilities.title: Multi-venue acquisition across Kalshi, Polymarket, and external anchors
capabilities.whyItMatters: Alpha and robustness depend on seeing the same economic event through multiple market structures and reference feeds.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Expand beyond BTC into additional anchored families and retain more complete quote history.

capabilities.title: Historical point-in-time replay for research snapshots and experiments
capabilities.whyItMatters: A quant stack is not credible if historical insights cannot be regenerated without look-ahead.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add portfolio-aware historical replay with archived quote surfaces and event clocks.

capabilities.title: Artifact lineage from raw payload to research output
capabilities.whyItMatters: Researchers need to audit exactly which payloads and transforms produced each score or signal.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Stamp all artifacts with dataset ids, schema versions, and model provenance.

capabilities.title: Canonical contract semantics
capabilities.whyItMatters: Without canonical semantics, calibration, aggregation, and cross-market comparisons are unreliable.
evidence: Normalization modules for contracts, thresholds, buckets, rules, and families
capabilities.nextMilestone: Extend canonical semantics to more family types and explicit resolution ambiguity controls.

capabilities.title: Relationship graph for monotonicity, complement, partition, and nesting edges
capabilities.whyItMatters: Internal-consistency alpha and portfolio de-duplication both depend on a correct contract graph.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add cross-venue event linking and explicit ladder overlap matrices.

capabilities.title: Anchor-driven fair-value baselines
capabilities.whyItMatters: A hedge-fund-grade process starts with interpretable baseline models before higher-complexity models are added.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add more family-specific baseline models and benchmark tables.

capabilities.title: Proper scoring, calibration, and segment-aware evaluation
capabilities.whyItMatters: Brier, log loss, calibration error, and walk-forward testing are table stakes for probabilistic models.
evidence: Barrier backtest with Brier and log loss
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add rolling walk-forward retraining, calibration drift monitoring, and hypothesis tests.

capabilities.title: Model library spanning structural, external-anchor, and flow signals
capabilities.whyItMatters: The best end state combines complementary alpha sleeves rather than relying on one modeling idea.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Introduce a model registry plus ensemble diagnostics for multiple sleeves.

capabilities.domainTitle: Simulation, Paper Trading, And Execution Realism
capabilities.title: Deterministic execution-template simulations
capabilities.whyItMatters: Even a first simulator should quantify how much edge survives after execution style choices.
evidence: Internal-consistency and BTC anchor experiment runners
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add queue-position, depth-consumption, and latency-aware execution simulation.

capabilities.domainTitle: Simulation, Paper Trading, And Execution Realism
capabilities.title: Persistent paper trading loops
capabilities.whyItMatters: Live paper loops reveal operational and portfolio problems that static backtests miss.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Promote from single-sleeve loops to unified multi-sleeve portfolio paper trading.

capabilities.domainTitle: Simulation, Paper Trading, And Execution Realism
capabilities.title: Portfolio-aware historical replay
capabilities.whyItMatters: A complete quant stack should replay position evolution, risk accumulation, and turnover through history.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Extend research backfill into a historical portfolio simulator using archived market surfaces.

capabilities.title: Overlap-aware sizing and concentration controls
capabilities.whyItMatters: Threshold ladders and related event families can silently magnify the same economic bet.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Generalize from single-family controls to portfolio-wide correlation and scenario exposure controls.

capabilities.title: Stress testing and scenario analytics
capabilities.whyItMatters: Senior quants expect scenario-aware risk, not just realized PnL summaries.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add regime shock tables, event co-resolution scenarios, and liquidity stress overlays.

capabilities.title: Capital allocator across sleeves and venues
capabilities.whyItMatters: The finished platform should decide not only what to trade, but how much budget each sleeve deserves.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Implement expected-value, confidence, and crowding-aware sleeve allocation.

capabilities.title: Model, dataset, and artifact provenance
capabilities.whyItMatters: Without provenance, live recommendations cannot be audited or trusted.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Add run manifests tying research outputs to model version, config hash, and input artifact ids.

capabilities.title: Monitoring for data freshness, model drift, and execution anomalies
capabilities.whyItMatters: Production failure usually starts with stale feeds or silently degraded behavior.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Emit freshness and drift scorecards plus loop health alerts.

capabilities.title: Promotion gates from research to paper to production
capabilities.whyItMatters: A strong research shop has explicit criteria for what earns more capital and automation.
capabilities.nextMilestone: Define go/no-go scorecards with minimum calibration, turnover, and drawdown thresholds.
